messages:
nora: quick UX spike  audit CSV headers and the KMS label copy are causing confusion in support. users can't tell which keys are customer-managed vs platform-managed at a glance.

ash: can you share examples? i saw a ticket where someone thought "Redwood-managed" meant we have access to plaintext keys. :grimacing: 

nora: exactly. current table shows "Key: redwood/key-123" and a small badge that says "Managed". support had to dig into the key detail.

devin: proposal: change badge text to "Redwood-managed (no customer key)"? that might be long. maybe use 2 badges: "Redwood-managed" and a tooltip: "This key is managed by Redwood. We do not have access to customer plaintext. Click for details."

maria: accessibility note: tooltip must not rely on hover. add focusable info icon with aria-expanded to open the details panel. Also the badge contrast is currently failing AA on dark theme.

ash: another angle: rename column header from "Key" to "Encryption key (KMS)" so exports read better. audit CSV currently has header "key_name" which confused legal reviews.

nora: yes please. CSV header change: "encryption_key_arn" -> "kms_key_arn" and add a human-friendly column "kms_key_label" which contains masked label like "Customer KMS 34ABCD". (masking scheme: show last 4).

devin: implementation detail: we'll keep the raw arn in export zipped "raw_metadata.json" for SEPs, but default CSV should be safer for share.

maria: microcopy suggestion for the KMS badge tooltip: "Customer-managed KMS (last 4: ABCD). Click "View key details" for the ARN and rotation policy." also ensure copy button has aria-label="Copy KMS ARN".

kevin-bot: checklist: add CSV header migration note to changelog, bump API minor version, add unit test for csv export headers, axe: color-contrast checks.

ash: small retention label nit: current UI shows "30d" which is ambiguous in some languages. suggest full label "Retention: 30 days" on hover and aria-label="Retention period: 30 days". icon-only on mobile ok if aria provided.

nora: agree. also mobile layout: prefer region first, then resource name, then badges stacked. this reduces horizontal scrolling during support sessions.

maria: will run quick a11y diff once changes are on a branch. callout: screen readers should announce when export is available and whether it contains full ARNs. add aria-live notification for export job completion.

devin: i'll draft the PR: CSV changes + badge copy + a small UI tweak for mobile stacking. estimate 3 days.

ash: thanks. nora can you update the support KB copy for the label changes so tickets don't explode?

nora: yep will update KB and add example CSV snippet. linking when done.

kevin-bot: release-checklist: notify partners about CSV header change, add migration guide.

maria: queued for accessibility review after PR lands.

ash: great, closing thread after PR merges.
